post_revisions_identity_check.name: post_revisions_identity_check
post_revisions_identity_check.value:
(
        "post_revisions"."change_type" = 'BASELINE'
        AND "post_revisions"."revision_number" = 1
        AND "post_revisions"."actor_id" IS NULL
        AND "post_revisions"."snapshot_hash" IS NULL
        AND "post_revisions"."snapshot_hash_version" IS NULL
        AND "post_revisions"."operation_record_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "post_revisions"."change_type" <> 'BASELINE'
        AND "post_revisions"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND length("post_revisions"."actor_id") > 0
        AND "post_revisions"."snapshot_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND length("post_revisions"."snapshot_hash") = 64
        AND "post_revisions"."snapshot_hash_version" IS NOT NULL
        AND "post_revisions"."snapshot_hash_version" >= 1
        AND "post_revisions"."operation_record_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

post_revisions_initial_number_check.name: post_revisions_initial_number_check
post_revisions_initial_number_check.value:
(
        "post_revisions"."change_type" IN ('CREATE', 'BASELINE')
        AND "post_revisions"."revision_number" = 1
      ) OR (
        "post_revisions"."change_type" NOT IN ('CREATE', 'BASELINE')
        AND "post_revisions"."revision_number" > 1
      )
